relevant.description: Verdict for this company against the query. 'relevant' = every query criterion is directly supported by the fact pack. 'not_relevant' = at least one criterion is contradicted by the fact pack. 'info_insufficient' = no criterion is contradicted, but the fact pack is silent or too vague on at least one criterion.

relevant_rationale.description: 1-3 sentences citing the specific facts from the fact pack that drove the verdict. For not_relevant, name the failed criterion and the contradicting fact. For info_insufficient, name which criteria the fact pack is silent on.
